summary: Galaxy imports semver Git tags as role versions; install one with role,version, or install from Git with a branch or commit hash after the comma.
questions: How do I install a specific version of a Galaxy role?
How do I install a role from a specific Git commit?
How do I see what versions a role has?

answer_card.title: Install a specific role version
answer_card.answer_md:
See available versions on the role's Galaxy page. Then:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role install geerlingguy.apache,3.2.0
```
Or straight from Git with a branch or commit:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role install git+https://github.com/geerlingguy/ansible-role-apache.git,0b7cd353c0250e87a26e0499e59e7fd265cc2f25
```
